queries.title: Required verify duration — p50 (latest snapshot)
queries.description: Histogram estimate over the latest retained required-verdict job snapshot. A single run per label set is not a cohort median; cohort p50/p95 requires the 14-day sample rule.

queries.title: Required verify duration — p95 (latest snapshot)
queries.description: Same snapshot as p50. Shown for shape, not as a cohort p95 guarantee. Bucket bounds are explicit, so the estimate is limited by bucket width.

queries.title: Build cache layer hit ratio — snapshot by lane
queries.description: Layers in state warm divided by layers in warm or cold. Partial, invalidated and disabled layers are excluded from the denominator. Empty means no telemetry, not a zero hit ratio.

queries.title: Build cache transfer bytes — not yet emitted
queries.description: Restore/upload bytes are not in ci-performance-evidence/1.0. This panel stays empty until a byte source exists; it never reads zero.

queries.title: Tests selected by planner — latest snapshot
queries.description: Planner-selected test count per lane and test scope (affected or full). Compare affected against full on the same lane; not a cumulative total across runs.

queries.title: Tests executed now — latest snapshot
queries.description: Tests actually run in this execution (verified-from-cache tests are not included). The gap to selected is cache-verified work, not a failure.

queries.title: Spring Context creations — not yet emitted
queries.description: Context creation counts are not in ci-performance-evidence/1.0; context timing is shown as a span only. Empty means no telemetry, never zero context loads.

queries.title: Testcontainers startup — mean by lane
queries.description: Mean of the container-preparation histogram for the retained snapshot. The lane is the consumer-declared producer lane, not a per-container label.

queries.title: Gradle task time — mean by lane
queries.description: Mean of the Gradle task-category histogram. Nested Context, container and Flyway time is inside the test span and is not added to this value.

queries.title: Affected fallback to full verification — not yet emitted
queries.description: Fallback count and type need a planner source that is not in ci-performance-evidence/1.0. Empty means unknown, not zero fallbacks.

queries.title: Selection mismatch — not yet emitted
queries.description: Affected success followed by full failure needs the paired-run comparator. Empty means unknown, never zero mismatches.

queries.title: Workflow results — retained snapshot counts
queries.description: Observation counts per result label (success, failure, cancellation, timeout, unknown). Snapshot counts only; not a failure rate, flaky rate or lifetime counter.

queries.title: Collector self-scrape health — 1 up / 0 down
queries.description: Scrape health for the Collector used by this dashboard. Zero means the exporter-side panels cannot observe delivery; it is not a CI conclusion.

queries.title: Flyway spans inside the tests span
queries.description: Each row is a Flyway span nested in its run's tests span. Placement is unverified (start at tests start, clipped to tests duration). Open the trace for the waterfall.
queries.query: { resource.service.name = "onmaru-ci" && span.toolkit.ci.nested_in = "tests" && name = "flyway" && span.cicd.pipeline.name = "ci" && span.vcs.repository.name = "YRootLab/OnMaru-backend" && span.cicd.pipeline.run.id =~ "[1-9][0-9]{0,18}" } | select(span.cicd.pipeline.run.id, span.toolkit.ci.run.attempt, span.toolkit.ci.manifest.digest)

queries.title: Context and container spans inside the tests span
queries.description: Spring Context and Testcontainers preparation nested in the tests span. Their durations are inside test time and must not be summed with it.
queries.query: { resource.service.name = "onmaru-ci" && span.toolkit.ci.nested_in = "tests" && name =~ "context_init|container_prepare" && span.cicd.pipeline.name = "ci" && span.vcs.repository.name = "YRootLab/OnMaru-backend" && span.cicd.pipeline.run.id =~ "[1-9][0-9]{0,18}" } | select(span.cicd.pipeline.run.id, span.toolkit.ci.run.attempt, span.toolkit.ci.manifest.digest)

queries.title: Layer run traces — up to 20 matches
queries.description: One trace per run with the observed job window and its nested waterfall. Open the Tempo trace for the waterfall, or use the run's Actions and manifest links. The source verdict is the result column.
queries.query: { resource.service.name = "onmaru-ci" && span.toolkit.ci.scope = "layer-run" && span.cicd.pipeline.name = "ci" && span.vcs.repository.name = "YRootLab/OnMaru-backend" && span.cicd.pipeline.run.id =~ "[1-9][0-9]{0,18}" } | select(span.cicd.pipeline.run.id, span.toolkit.ci.run.attempt, span.toolkit.ci.manifest.digest, span.cicd.pipeline.result)
